title: Manager Behavior × AGI living 44-slide research-lab deck
research_context: internal and educational, not independently peer reviewed

numerical_and_material_claims.claim: Radiant company reported 2,796 synthetic respondents, 68,280 answers, seven human survey sources; population TVD 0.08 vs 0.31.
numerical_and_material_claims.method: Matched-profile survey-answer model comparison on cited company benchmark; population-level TVD.
numerical_and_material_claims.limits: Not independently reproduced by Manager; not individual action accuracy or real-world causal welfare.

numerical_and_material_claims.claim: Eleven validity tests grouped internal 4, construct 3, external 4.
numerical_and_material_claims.method: Published framework and formal diagnostic definitions for human-referenced simulation.
numerical_and_material_claims.limits: Framework paper; not proof that all product models pass the battery or generalize to welfare interventions.

numerical_and_material_claims.claim: 33,299 LLM chatbots formed language/content homophily clusters in simulated online network.
numerical_and_material_claims.method: Aggregate social network simulation measuring homophily.
numerical_and_material_claims.limits: Homophily alone is not survey or real-world intervention validation.

numerical_and_material_claims.claim: SocSci210 metadata: 210 studies split 170 seen and 40 unseen with zero overlapping IDs.
numerical_and_material_claims.method: Immutable study-ID mapping, Git blob hash, disjointness check.
numerical_and_material_claims.limits: No participant-response benchmark or consent coverage established.

numerical_and_material_claims.claim: Simile reports ~8,600 held-out evaluation questions, hidden-state uncertainty probe AUROC 0.73 and 0.16 internal TVD decision threshold.
numerical_and_material_claims.method: Question/sample-grouped CV and predicted simulation-error scoring.
numerical_and_material_claims.limits: Not independently reproduced; threshold is internal human-rater alignment, not a universal causal threshold.

numerical_and_material_claims.claim: Original paper 6,061 available decision points, source CSV 8,274; Manager nonidentical exploratory sample 6,330.
numerical_and_material_claims.method: Human micro-randomized study; public CSV source audit; alternative correlation analysis.
numerical_and_material_claims.limits: Exact H005 analysis population not reproducible; no equivalent randomized causal-effect replication.

numerical_and_material_claims.claim: 365 days from 2011 fit, 366 days from 2012 held out; MAE 2488.67 vs 2303.65 daily rentals for simple baselines.
numerical_and_material_claims.method: Real aggregate daily bike rents, out-of-year holdout; 7-day paired block bootstrap interval includes zero.
numerical_and_material_claims.limits: Observed aggregate behavior, not individual survey prediction or randomized causal effect.

numerical_and_material_claims.claim: 184/184 historic Manager tests passed; scoped Phase04 5/8 done; zero independently proven beneficiaries.
numerical_and_material_claims.method: Hosted GitHub Actions test and task-registry readback.
numerical_and_material_claims.limits: Passing tests is software evidence; zero proven benefit means NOT_MEASURED, not evidence that real-world suffering is zero.

numerical_and_material_claims.claim: Manager's general-purpose public-benefit autonomy and transparent Blessing evidence loop.
numerical_and_material_claims.method: Research questions, planned architecture and evidence taxonomy.
numerical_and_material_claims.limits: Never present design intent, simulation artifacts or tool success as field-verified benefit.
